pages.title: M-Theory Core
pages.text: Five superstring theories turned out to be limits of one eleven-dimensional theory, whose fundamental objects include membranes as well as strings. Witten called it M-theory, and nobody knows what the M stands for. The core vibrates in more directions than seem possible.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Wrapping an M-brane on a G2 manifold and a compactified circle in the Compactification Lathe, I found all five string theories as limits of one. Exotic matter kept the eleventh dimension open.
